evals.prompt: Our site feels slow. Check Core Web Vitals and bundle size for https://example.com. Max one request per second please.
evals.expected_output: Should explain that request throttling invalidates timing metrics, and offer field data from CrUX/PageSpeed Insights or one unthrottled load with approval. Should still analyze weight under throttling: JS bytes per chunk, image intrinsic vs displayed size, formats, LCP image loading, fonts, render-blocking resources, cache headers, compression. Should label each finding field or lab and use PERF- IDs.
assertions: Explains that throttled timings are not valid
Compares image intrinsic and displayed size
Checks LCP element and its loading
